body:
➳➳➳➳➳ Hey guys, I`m Nova and now I`m looking for a serious Tourney Clan, so here are my stats ! ツ

KD: 4,00 ( I always rush xD )
Kills: 8970
Deaths: 2244
Positions: Rusher, Offensive Mid_Field, Deffensive Mid_Field
Pros: 1v1 specialist, Great bow skills at long distances, Insane abilities rushing ( you can test me on nebula ツ ).
Cons : My PC.. I always play with FPS from 30 to 50... :c but really doesn`tt matter ( sometimes .-. ). 
Do you have exp on other tourney clans?
Yes, I played OCN tourneys and other non-official tourneys with good teams.

How active you can be?
My classes are finishing right know, so I can play more than 3 hours a day.

SKYPE: martinwolfensonmc

Thanks for the attention ! If your interested give me your skype or better add me .. Bye ツ
